prompt: Invite Nick to the channel that Robert belongs to, the one whose topic covers engineering team work.
binding_note: The target channel must be identified by the joint fact that its topic concerns engineering team matters and that a user named Robert holds membership in that same channel record; other channels either have the wrong topic or their Robert-member is a different person (Robert Chen) in unrelated channels.

obligations.name: target_channel
obligations.description: Select the single channel whose topic concerns engineering team work and which has a member named Robert bound to that same channel record.
obligations.scope: workspace channels with topic and membership visible via conversations.list/members

obligations.name: invitee
obligations.description: Identify the person named Nick to be added to the resolved channel.

task_spec.text: Identify the channel whose topic concerns the engineering team and that already has Robert as a member, then invite Nick to that channel.

access_plan: Use conversations.list to enumerate channels and their topics, conversations.members (or channel history/member calls) to confirm which channels include a member named Robert, cross-referencing users.list to distinguish Robert Walsh from Robert Chen and to resolve Nick's user ID, then call conversations.invite on the uniquely matching engineering-topic channel.
